Inside that region, show an intense compact brightening or paired flare ribbons and a short connected coronal response in nearby loops or plasma. The event stays localized on the disk as an active-region eruption rather than dominating the entire scene. Use crisp instrument detail, controlled cabin light, and credible photographic depth.
